entity.name: Akos Foldesi
entity.description: Creator and sole maintainer of OpenEUDI, the open-source EUDI Wallet verification toolkit for TypeScript.

projects.name: @openeudi/dcql
projects.description: DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) implementation for OpenID4VP 1.0. Zero-dependency TypeScript library for DCQL query validation, credential matching (SD-JWT VC, mDOC, custom formats), and spec-shaped submission building.
